evidence: Morphology and composition of the samples were investigated by SEM and TEM. High resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) and electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS). Transmission electron microscopy measurements were performed using a CM200FEG (Philips) microscope operated at 200 kV. The thickness of the coating was determined by HRTEM on MOx–CNTs samples and by X-ray reflectometry (XRR) on films deposited on silicon wafers. The X-ray diffractometer used was a Philips X’Pert MPD with a copper radiation (λ Ka = 1.54056 Å) and a graphite monochromator for the selection of pure K a radiation. Thermal analysis was carried out on a Mettler Toledo thermal gravimetric analyzer (TGA).
